changes: Implemented host-neutral dispatch_run/overflow_auto surfaces: runtime probe/list, dispatch plan/prepare/run/collect/status/list/resume/cancel/review/receipt/merge_plan, fake runner, real-host scaffold, path containment, host identity receipts, docs and smoke coverage.
usage: Use lattice host_runtime_list/probe, dispatch_plan, dispatch_prepare, dispatch_run, overflow_auto, dispatch_collect, dispatch_review, dispatch_receipt_create, and dispatch_merge_plan with --format=json for supervised host overflow.
expectedOutcome: User can run dispatch_run or overflow_auto from Lattice CLI and see supervised cross-host overflow with visible degradation, accepted_local fake receipts, manual review/merge guidance, and productionDone=false.
actualTranscript: Local validation passed: dispatch-run, host-overflow, lattice-handoff, command ownership, process fact, evidence freshness dry-run, delivery check, and koala validate all passed with 45/45 verification intents covered.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible gap for the scoped story; real host execution remains scaffolded/manual-first by design and cannot claim DONE.
limitations: Real Codex/Claude/Gemini hosts are scaffolded and supervised; this story intentionally does not implement server receipt verification, automatic merge, or productionDone authority.
pitfalls: Main pitfalls fixed during review were overflow_auto approval semantics, symlink/path escape containment, output path escape, mixed parallel outcome aggregation, stale verification evidence, and Gemini/Codex receipt host identity.
